summary: Continues the search path: role subdirectories, then paths from ansible.cfg or env vars (DEFAULT_MODULE_PATH, ANSIBLE_LIBRARY, etc.), then built-in directories. User files override standard ones, even generic names like basic.py.
questions: Can my own file override a built-in module_util like basic.py?
Which config settings and env vars add module and plugin paths?
What decides which of two same-named custom plugins is used?

answer_card.title: Ansible search path (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
4. Configured paths: `DEFAULT_MODULE_PATH`, `DEFAULT_MODULE_UTILS_PATH`, `DEFAULT_CACHE_PLUGIN_PATH`, `DEFAULT_FILTER_PLUGIN_PATH`, or env vars `ANSIBLE_LIBRARY`, `ANSIBLE_MODULE_UTILS`, `ANSIBLE_CACHE_PLUGINS`, `ANSIBLE_FILTER_PLUGINS`.
5. Standard built-in directories.

**Caution:** user files override built-ins, even generic names (a `basic.py` overrides `ansible.module_utils.basic`). With duplicates, CLI order and include/role order decide which wins.
